Name: Duck Paintings
Author: QueenQuackin
Description:
[b][i][u][size=6]Update 3.0.0 is here!![/size]
[/u][/i][/b][size=3]What's new in this update?
[/size]4 new ducks!!
> The new ducks are a Detective, Farmer McQuackin, The Quackerson Sisters (Duck Play on Hocus Pocus), and most importantly a conQUACKulations duck! Ty so much for all of the love and support this mod has gotten!
> The CP version has a config option so that you can choose which frames you do or don't want to use. The default only has walnut enabled. The paintings were also given new (Funny) names.
> For AT There are now five separate downloads so you can decide which frames you do or don't want to use as I'm sure you don't want 85+ duck painting options... or maybe you do in which case fair enough. 

[b][i][u][size=5]For AT users only! If you reskinned 'A Night on Echo-Hill' with one of the ducks it will now not work and you will need to use another painting to reskin! This painting now has the Ducktective and the Farmer to choose from.[/size][/u][/i][/b]


As a rubber duck enthusiast I thought the game needed some rubber duck paintings!

There are two versions you can download based on how you like your game play.

The CP Version adds NEW paintings to the game via a furniture catalogue that can be purchased at Robins, spawned in through CJB Item Spawner, or you can access the catalogue and the paintings through happy home designer.

The AT version makes the paintings accessible through the paint bucket for alternative textures. If you use Happy Home Designer you will be able to change the textures through there as well.

I hope you have a Quacking good time with these paintings! I'd love to see how you use these in your farmhouses so please feel free to post your images in the media section or in the posts section. 

[b][i][u]Compatibility 
[/u][/i][/b]No currently known issues

Have a problem? No worries please leave a comment and Post your SMAPI Log.
